crime: During free time, {WITCH_NAME}'s usual companion always chose whether they would read in the library or play pool. Before the companion even asked, {WITCH_NAME} would have the chosen book, cue, seat, or extra layer ready.

One evening, a message invited her to walk by the lake. {WITCH_NAME} wanted to go and began typing an acceptance, but the companion took her phone, declined it for her, and decided that they would play pool as usual.
The roommate saw them enter the recreation room together that evening. {WITCH_NAME}'s forearms were unmarked. The companion told the roommate that she had chosen pool for both of them.

During the game, {WITCH_NAME} rolled a ball beneath the pool table. When the companion bent to retrieve it, {WITCH_NAME} forced her under the table. The companion scratched {WITCH_NAME}'s forearm during the struggle. {WITCH_NAME} touched the table and made it extremely heavy. All four feet sank into the floor, one leg broke, and the tabletop fell onto the companion and crushed her chest. {WITCH_NAME} then restored the table's usual weight.

{WITCH_NAME} returned to the cell alone with fresh scratches and told the roommate that the companion had stayed behind to practise. The roommate later found the dead girl under the fallen table and initially believed that a leg had failed while she was reaching beneath it.

Four fresh, deep impressions marked the places where the table's feet had stood, although the table at its restored weight could not have made them. The four simultaneous marks and the broken leg showed that the whole table had briefly become much heavier, which required her to touch it. Blood under the dead girl's fingernails matched the fresh scratches on the forearm of the woman who returned alone. The roommate had seen her enter without scratches and return alone with them. Those traces placed her in the struggle and exposed the structural accident as a cover.
fields.epitaph: Empty-handed, she receives the final offering she cannot refuse.
execution: A high-backed feeding chair holds her arms and torso beneath broad restraints, while a wide band pins her forehead to the backrest. A large iron spoon rises from a full bowl and swings toward her mouth.

Again and again, the spoon forces thick food between her teeth. She cannot turn her head or use her hands. Each stroke packs more food into her mouth and throat. Even after her airway is blocked and her chest stops moving, the spoon brings her another mouthful.

magic.name: Weight Control
magic.text: She can change the weight of anything she touches.
